_comment: Garmin MCP intentionally NOT autostarted — see PLAN.md Resolved decisions. Empty-env retry-loops can 429-throttle the user's IP, and garth (its underlying Python lib) is deprecated. Run manually via `npx -y @nicolasvegam/garmin-connect-mcp` for ad-hoc Garmin questions; primary access via tools/*.py + python-garminconnect>=0.3.3.
